SCT_CityRegion.name: The City
SCT_CityRegion.text: Contemporary dense city of apartments, sidewalks, trains, cafés, rehearsal rooms and night spaces. It should feel inhabited rather than iconic: routine pressure, small warmth, practical light, crowds and private lives overlapping.

SCT_InnerRegion.name: Pattern Space
SCT_InnerRegion.text: Alex's subjective interior theatrical plane. Graphite grids, handwritten equations, circuitry, margins, constellations and recursive movement externalize thought. Never treat it as literal science-fiction reality.

SCT_CommunityRegion.name: Community Space
SCT_CommunityRegion.text: Mira's emerging world of communal music and movement. Human-scale rooms, chairs, found percussion, bodies in imperfect circles and daylight. Coherence without uniformity.
